titleStmt.title: E. List of Participants in the Geneva Conference on Korea

div.head: E. List of Participants in the Geneva Conference on Korea
div.p: Reprinted from The Korean Problem at the Geneva Conference, pages 21–26. With the exception of the United States Delegation, here listed first, the delegations of the other countries are not complete and list only the principal officials who played a prominent role in the Conference. The delegation lists are filed in Conference files, lot 60 D 627, CF 299 and CF 302.

quote.p: Through May 2—John Foster Dulles, Secretary of State
